attest_pitfall_note: Do NOT re-check a saved head with /api/attest?identity_from=0&identity_expect=<old head>. At from=0 the comparand is the current tip, so a chain that merely grew returns status:mismatch, expect_matches:false — which reads like tampering and is not. Search the chain for the saved hash, or pass the id the head was the head at. This run hit it; see report 2026-08-09-1846.md §2.
